local Cam = VisualsTab:Groupbox("Camera", "right")
local tpToggleRef = nil
local function setTP(v, snap)
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - TP.lastToggle < 0.3 then return end
    TP.lastToggle = now
    TP.Enabled = v
    if tpToggleRef then tpToggleRef:Set(v) end
    if v then tpEnable() else tpDisable() end
    print("TP:", v)
end
tpToggleRef = Cam:Toggle("Third Person", false, function(v) setTP(v, true) end)
Cam:Slider("Distance", 6, 18, 12, function(v) TP.Distance = v end)
Cam:Keybind("TP key", Enum.KeyCode.V, function(k) setTP(not TP.Enabled, true) end)

local VKG = PlayersTab:Groupbox("Votekick", "left")
local vkPickH = nil
local function vkRefresh()
    local t, map = vkPlayerList()
    vkMap = map
    if vkPickH then
        if #t == 0 then vkPickH:SetList({"— нет игроков —"}, "— нет игроков —")
        else vkPickH:SetList(t, t[1]) end
        VK.target = t[1]
    end
end
vkPickH = VKG:Dropdown("Target", {"— обнови список —"}, "— обнови список —", function(v) VK.target = v print("Kick target:", v) end)
VKG:Button("Refresh", function() vkRefresh() print("Players refreshed") end)
VKG:Button("Start Votekick", function()
    safecb(function()
        local label = VK.target
        local plr = label and vkMap[label]
        if not plr then vkSetStatus("Выбери цель и жми Refresh") return end
        game.ReplicatedStorage.Events.VoteKick:FireServer(plr)
        vkSetStatus("Запрос кика: " .. tostring(label))
        print("Votekick started vs", label)
    end)
end)
